models.name: haiku
models.when: A quick, self-contained job with an obvious answer: a factual or how-do-I question, reading or summarising a file, a rename, formatting, a one-line fix, running a command and reporting what it printed.

models.name: sonnet
models.when: Ordinary software work with a clear goal: building a well-specified feature or script, fixing a bug whose cause is known or easy to find, writing tests, refactoring within a few files, a routine review.

models.name: opus
models.when: Work where a mistake is costly or the path is unclear: designing an architecture, debugging something whose cause is unknown, a change that spans many files or systems, security-sensitive or data-migration work, subtle concurrency or performance problems, open-ended research or planning.

efforts.name: low
efforts.when: The answer or edit is immediate; there is nothing to weigh or plan.

efforts.name: medium
efforts.when: A handful of steps carried out in an obvious order, with little to decide along the way.

efforts.name: high
efforts.when: Several interacting parts or trade-offs to think through before acting, or a cause that has to be investigated first.

efforts.name: xhigh
efforts.when: A hard, ambiguous or high-stakes problem where many possibilities must be explored and the result carefully verified.
